description: Pointer is a workflow automation platform. A procedure is an ordered set of plain-language instructions that Pointer executes against a team's real business systems such as CRMs, email, spreadsheets, ticketing and accounting tools. With this plugin the user works inside their own Pointer workspace with exactly the access they have in Pointer: list and read procedures, build or edit a procedure from plain language and preview or undo the change, run a procedure and wait for the result, read the logs, step reasoning, screenshots and files a run produced, debug and retry failed runs, pause or cancel running procedures, inspect triggers, variables and credentials, search the workspace knowledge base and link documents to a procedure, and hand open-ended requests to Scout, Pointer's own agent, which pauses for the user's approval before anything consequential. Every write or execute tool is marked non-read-only so the client can ask for confirmation first. Human-in-the-loop approvals inside a run are never resolved by the plugin.

defaultPrompt: Show me the procedures in my team and what each one does
Why did the last run of the weekly invoice report fail?
Build a procedure that emails me a summary of new HubSpot deals every Monday
